meaning: In TALK mode the legend rewrites any whole "M<digit>" token (M2..M9) to "M2", so a figure reads as "baseline vs comparison" instead of naming the numbered model. The comment claims this is safe because every deck is M1-vs-one-other.

could_move.what: The rewrite happens at plot time in the shared plotting path, so any TALK-mode replot picks it up without a re-fit.

expectation: Legend text only; no change to trajectories or fitted parameters. For M1-vs-one-other decks the effect is the intended single rename. For the m4_vs_m5 decks the expected effect is a wrong figure: two distinct curves labelled the same. I cannot tell from this context whether those decks are ever replotted in TALK mode.

check.why: Replots one already-solved deck with no re-fit, and it is the deck where the comment's M1-vs-one-other assumption fails; inspect the legend for two "M2" entries.
